issues.title: Session repo identity never binds on host 2.1.4 — recall silently partitions writes under the server cwd
P0: Lock read-modify-write paths (canonical registry, snapshot restore) — two-writer stress
persistent prompt injection: framing + provenance for injected memory blocks; stricter import policy
viewer: malformed Host header throws before the guard — Bun dev error page discloses stack/paths
Auto-capture is silently dead on opencode 2.x: session.idle envelope read misses event.data
Per-session caches (epoch, latestPrompt, sessionStats) grow unbounded in a long-lived server
